si3_author_journal_year: Inês Won Sampaio et al., Artificial Intelligence In Medicine, 2025
si4_title: A generalizable normative deep autoencoder for brain morphological anomaly detection: application to the multi-site StratiBip dataset on bipolar disorder in an external validation framework

dc1_datasets_using.detail: HCP-YA was used as the normative training set. StratiBip (a multi-site dataset from the StratiBip network) was used as the external test set, including healthy controls and patients with bipolar disorder.
dc1_datasets_using.supporting_text: The normative model framework was trained on the confounders-free brain features extracted from the human connectome project young adults (HCP-YA) dataset [28] and applied to multi-site data from the StratiBip network [16], including HC and subjects with BD.
dc1_datasets_using.location: Sampaio2025.pdf.md: Abstract; 3. Materials and methods / 3.1. Data

answer.HCP-YA: normative training and validation for model-1

answer.StratiBip: external test sets for anomaly detection and clinical research (HC for establishing external normative range and BD for patient-level evaluation)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP-YA (N=1109) was used to train the deep autoencoder and tune hyperparameters. StratiBip (N=550 total) was used for external validation: 363 HC were used to compare with the normative model and 187 BD patients were used for clinical anomaly detection.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The normative model framework was trained on the confounders-free brain features extracted from the human connectome project young adults (HCP-YA) dataset... and applied to multi-site data from the StratiBip network... The external test set consisted of data collected as part of the StratiBip network... 550 subjects, 363 HC... and 187 with BD.

dc3_hc_n_of_each_normative_model.detail: Train phase used the full HCP-YA healthy control dataset (N=1109). The overall phase includes the HCP-YA training set and the external StratiBip healthy control test set (N=363).
dc3_hc_n_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: HCP-YA... 1109 HC subjects... StratiBip dataset... 363 HC... across 7 sites.
dc3_hc_n_of_each_normative_model.location: Sampaio2025.pdf.md: 3.1.1. Normative training set: HCP dataset; 3.1.2. StratiBip dataset: external test set

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Overall phase statistics were calculated by weighting the HCP-YA and StratiBip-HC statistics. Train phase statistics were directly extracted from the HCP-YA sample description. Age range was restricted to young adults (22-37) for both datasets.

Mean ± std: 28.811 ± 3.693; median [25th; 75th]: 29.0 [26.0; 32.0]). HC-StratiBip: 363 HC (median age = 27.00 years... Mean ± std: 27.741 ± 3.999; median [25th; 75th]: 27.0 [25.0; 31.0]).

dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Train phase sex info corresponds to the HCP-YA dataset. Overall phase sex info combines HCP-YA and StratiBip-HC. Percentages were calculated from the reported Ns.
dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: HCP-YA: 604 females, 505 males. HC-StratiBip: 189 females, 174 males.
